subject: Mutual action plan + AWS private offer — NewLeaf evaluation & commit cadence
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Myers <sara@newleaf-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + AWS private offer — NewLeaf evaluation & commit cadence

Hi Sara — great to meet yesterday. As promised, attached is a compact mutual action plan (MAP) we can use to align evaluation milestones with a staged AWS Private Offer and pricing ramp. TL;DR: we propose a 12-week eval + pilot with three commit-triggered discount bands tied to a Marketplace Private Offer:

- Eval sprint (Weeks 1–3): P0 integration, perf baseline, 50k tokens/day sim workload.
- Pilot (Weeks 4–7): Live pilot on a single region, up to 200k tokens/day, SLO verification.
- Production ramp (Weeks 8–12): staged commits and discounts: 3-tier private-offer (base commit, mid-commit, enterprise-commit) that unlocks incremental discounts and burst capacity.

Attached: REDWOOD_MAP_NewLeaf_v1.pdf (MAP), PO_template_NewLeaf.docx (draft PO), and an AWS private-offer invite placeholder. Can we lock a joint working session next Tue Sep 14 10:00 PT to finalize milestones and procurement milestones? If that works I’ll share a draft private-offer link and the DocuSign route for PO signature.

Notes on pricing mechanics (summary):
- Base: $0.045/token-equivalent unit with standard support.
- Mid commit (>= $75k annualized): 12% discount + reserved burst lane.
- Enterprise commit (>= $250k annualized): 20% discount + SLA credits and dedicated capacity option.

I’ll bring Marcus (commercial) to the call for the private-offer walkthrough and Evelyn to review perf targets.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Connor — thanks for the plan and the materials. A few quick notes from procurement/legal and our infra lead (cc’d James):

- The 12-week timeline looks reasonable but we need a clearer gating criteria for the mid-commit (performance and security acceptance). Can we add an acceptance checklist tied to the MAP?
- Procurement prefers an AWS Private Offer flow so we can accept the PO directly via Marketplace; please include the private-offer ID and any required Marketplace terms.
- We will route the PO through finance next week; James and I will confirm the internal review timeline by Wed.

We can meet Tue 10:00 PT. Please include the private-offer link in the meeting notes and a short one-page summary of what the mid-commit dollar trigger buys (e.g., burst lanes, discounted tokens, and any reserved capacity).

—Sara
Sara Myers
Head of Product Operations | NewLeaf Retail
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Myers <sara@newleaf-retail.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + AWS private offer — NewLeaf evaluation & commit cadence

Thanks Sara — quick clarifying note on the private-offer mechanics so your procurement team has what they need: 

1) Private offer structure (summary):
   - Offer ID: abcd-1234 (Marketplace private offer; editable pre-signature)
   - Billing: Marketplace-managed invoicing; PO accepted via DocuSign link we provide.
   - Commit bands and commercial impact:
       * Band A (Eval / pilot baseline): No commit required; pay-as-you-go at $0.045/unit.
       * Band B (Mid-commit): $75k annualized commit -> 12% off unit price + 10% reserved burst capacity.
       * Band C (Enterprise): $250k annualized commit -> 20% off unit price + priority routing and SLA credits.

2) Ramp mechanics: Discounts are applied retroactively at the monthly invoice when the commit threshold is met. Bursts are capacity reservations we allocate in the target region for the pilot-to-prod transition.

3) Procurement artifacts: we’ll send the Marketplace Private Offer link + DocuSign-enabled PO. For internal review we’ll attach the Marketplace terms and a one-pager describing what each discount unlocks.

Attaching: aws-private-offer-invite.txt (placeholder link for Marketplace), and I’ll upload the one-pager after the meeting.

Connor — happy to run the private-offer demo in the Tue session and walk James through the PO flow.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws-private-offer-invite.txt
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Myers <sara@newleaf-retail.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 13:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + AWS private offer — NewLeaf evaluation & commit cadence

Hi all — adding a short technical checklist + week-by-week MAP items so the engineering and security gates are explicit:

Week 1–3 (Eval sprint):
- Integration: SDK keys, 1 integration test suite, baseline latency/throughput (50k tokens/day sim).
- Security: IAM roles, VPC endpoint for Private traffic (if using Private deployment), SOC2 checklist items: logging and audit sample.
- Deliverable: Integration runbook + perf report.

Week 4–7 (Pilot):
- Canary traffic in US-West-2, 50–200k tokens/day.
- Failure modes and fallback: configure automatic fallback to compatible model variant.
- Deliverable: Pilot SLO report and acceptance sign-off (security + infra).

Week 8–12 (Production ramp):
- Scale-up plan and private-offer commit trigger review.
- Procurement: PO signed via DocuSign, Marketplace offer accepted, and initial commit applied.
- Deliverable: Production runbook + capacity plan.

Perf targets to qualify for mid-commit: < 150ms tail latency P95 on the pilot workload, error rate < 0.5% over 24h, and successful KV cache warmup across sequences. If you want, Evelyn or I can add a short prompt set for quality regression checks tied to the MAP acceptance gate.

-Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Myers <sara@newleaf-retail.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Wong <james.wong@newleaf-retail.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + AWS private offer — NewLeaf evaluation & commit cadence

Connor/Team — this is very helpful, thank you. Confirming Tue 10:00 PT and that James will bring procurement questions. Two quick asks before the call: 

1) Please send the one-page commercial summary that maps Band B -> Band C to explicit operational benefits (burst capacity hours, reserved endpoints, SLA credits).
2) Send the Marketplace private-offer link and the DocuSign PO stub so finance can pre-run their checks.

Once we get those two artifacts we’ll expedite the internal review and aim to sign the Band B PO by end of month if pilot metrics are met. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sara
Sara Myers
Head of Product Operations | NewLeaf Retail
